title: 第19章 千金的女仆第20章 这场决斗没有一点不公平的地方
slug: 骑士先生魔王真的不存在啊
lines: 第19章千金的女仆
听到两个人贩子的话，藏在木箱子的三人悄悄顶开了木板，顺着那两人的目光看到了一位被单独关在木笼子里的女仆。
看见对方的第一眼，唐立马认出了这个女仆，这是镇长千金的贴身女仆。
不过女仆并未注意到他们，只是用厌恶的目光瞪着那两个人贩子。
“你之前不是骂得很凶吗？很吵来着，忽然不说话，让人怪不适应的。”人贩子说罢大笑几声，连心情都愉悦了不少。
“果然，这是认命了哈哈哈！”另一个人贩也发出了尖锐的笑声。
那位女仆不甘地闭上了眼睛，不想多看这两个人。
很可悲，但事实就是如此，她已知晓自己无法逃走才放弃了过于激烈的抵抗以及言语上的攻击。
“今天老大发那么大的火，还真是差点给我吓死呢。”
“谁说不是？”
“走走走，趁现在还有时间，我们去喝点。”
“诶！走……嗯？怎么感觉脑袋昏沉沉的？”
两个人贩正准备离开，却在迈步的时候变得摇摇晃晃。忽然脚下一软，两个人贩子就跌到了木笼旁。
哐当一声，两人撞在了大木笼的边缘，吓得那些人质快速退开。
被关在小木笼的女仆则好奇的看着他们，感觉有些古怪，却又不知道是什么缘故。
直到另外几道脚步声出现，女仆忽然睁大了眼睛，露出了不可思议的表情。
听到了脚步声的人贩子以为是其他同伴过来了，便开口道：“嘿，兄弟，帮忙拉一把。”
“是啊是啊，不知道怎么回事，突然就脚软了。”
唐带着两人走到了人贩身后，冷漠地看着他们。
大木笼里的人质看见姆莉与唐身上的衣服，便露出了惊惧的表情，而注意到人质们情绪反应的两个人贩反而因此更加确信身后的就是同伴。
“兄弟，别不说话啊，等下带你们喝酒去。”
“对对，不过这件怪事要先跟老大汇报才行。”
“你们恐怕没有机会了。”唐对二人做出了回应。
“不是，兄弟，你什么意思？”
“你不会想要替我们的活吧？”
听着二人的猜测，唐只是哼笑一声，随后充满气势的念了一声：“秘技——沉睡打击！”
还未等两个人贩弄清这是什么意思，唐的拳头就已经落在了两人的后脑。一人一拳，精确无误的将二人打入昏迷状态。
而这一幕也让大木笼里的人质们看呆了，想不通人贩怎么突然就内讧起来了。
“姑娘们是哪里人？不像新约镇上的。”将两个人贩弄到一旁，唐开口询问这些人质的来历。
他很确信这些人不是新约镇上的镇民。
“我们……”笼内的女性们相互看看，有些担忧，不愿意将自己的来历告知于唐。
“唐，她们是附近村镇的人，都是被抓来的。”那位被关在木笼子里的女仆认出唐之后便开口为他解惑。
“原来还有附近的人遭殃……”姆莉自语着，随后转向唐，“唐，看来他们并不针对固定城镇，而是针对一定范围内的所有人作案。”
唐点了点头，这就说明一个人贩集团窝点危害的人远超大家的预计，远远不止新约镇的妇女们遭难。
“真是罪大恶极啊。”辛西也听懂了这里面的意思，不禁感慨一声。

Chapter 19 The rich maid
After hearing the words of the two traffickers, the three people hiding in the wooden box quietly pushed open the wooden board. Following the eyes of the two people, they saw a maid locked alone in a wooden cage.
The first time he saw the other party, Tang immediately recognized the maid. She was the mayor's daughter's personal maid.
However, the maid didn't notice them and just stared at the two traffickers with disgust.
"Didn't you scold him fiercely before? You were very noisy and suddenly stopped talking, which made people uncomfortable." After saying this, the trafficker laughed a few times, and even felt a lot happier.
"Sure enough, this is acceptance of fate, hahaha!" Another trafficker also let out a sharp laugh.
The maid closed her eyes reluctantly, not wanting to look at these two people any more.
It's sad, but that's the fact. She already knew that she couldn't escape, so she gave up her excessive resistance and verbal attacks.
"The boss got so angry today that he almost scared me to death."
"Who says it's not?"
"Let's go for a drink while there's still time."
"Hey! Let's go...huh? Why do you feel so dizzy?"
The two traffickers were about to leave, but they became unsteady as they stepped. Suddenly, their feet gave way, and the two traffickers fell to the wooden cage.
With a clang, the two of them hit the edge of the large wooden cage, frightening the hostages to quickly retreat.
The maid who was locked in a small wooden cage looked at them curiously, feeling a little strange, but she didn't know why.
Until a few more footsteps appeared, the maid suddenly opened her eyes wide with an incredible expression.
The trafficker who heard the footsteps thought it was other companions coming, so he said: "Hey, brother, help me."
"Yes, yes, I don't know what happened, but my feet suddenly became weak."
Tang led the two of them behind the trafficker and looked at them indifferently.
The hostages in the big wooden cage showed frightened expressions when they saw the clothes on Mu Li and Tang. However, the two traffickers who noticed the emotional reactions of the hostages became even more convinced that the people behind them were their companions.
"Brother, don't be silent. I'll take you to drink later."
"Yes, but this strange thing must be reported to the boss first."
"I'm afraid you have no chance." Tang responded to the two.
"No, brother, what do you mean?"
"You don't want to do our job, do you?"
Listening to the two people's guesses, Tang just chuckled, and then said with great momentum: "Secret skill - Sleeping Strike!"
Before the two traffickers could figure out what this meant, Tang's fist had already landed on the back of their heads. One punch per person, knocking both of them into a coma with perfect accuracy.
This scene also stunned the hostages in the big wooden cage, wondering why the traffickers suddenly started fighting among themselves.
"Where are the girls from? It's not like they are from New Testament Town." After taking the two traffickers aside, Tang asked about the origins of these hostages.
He was convinced that these people were not New Testament townsfolk.
"We..." The women in the cage looked at each other, a little worried and unwilling to tell Yu Tang their origins.
"Tang, they are from nearby villages and towns, and they were all captured." After the maid in the wooden cage recognized Tang, she opened her mouth to clear up his confusion.
"It turns out that there are still people nearby who are suffering..." Muli muttered to herself, then turned to Tang, "Tang, it seems that they are not targeting fixed towns, but targeting everyone within a certain range."
Tang nodded, which showed that a human trafficking group's den harmed far more people than everyone expected, and far more than the women of New York Town suffered.
"It's such a heinous crime." Xinxi also understood the meaning and couldn't help sighing.
